import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Bitset128 {
        long high; // bits 64-127
        long low;  // bits 0-63

        public Bitset128() {
            this.high = 0L;
            this.low = 0L;
        }

        public Bitset128(long high, long low) {
            this.high = high;
            this.low = low;
        }

        public Bitset128(Bitset128 other) {
            this.high = other.high;
            this.low = other.low;
        }

        public static Bitset128 fromIndex(int index) {
            Bitset128 b = new Bitset128();
            if (index >= 64) {
                b.high = 1L << (index - 64);
            } else {
                b.low = 1L << index;
            }
            return b;
        }

        public boolean get(int index) {
            if (index >= 64) {
                return ((high >>> (index - 64)) & 1L) != 0;
            } else {
                return ((low >>> index) & 1L) != 0;
            }
        }

        public void set(int index, boolean value) {
            if (index >= 64) {
                if (value) {
                    high |= 1L << (index - 64);
                } else {
                    high &= ~(1L << (index - 64));
                }
            } else {
                if (value) {
                    low |= 1L << index;
                } else {
                    low &= ~(1L << index);
                }
            }
        }

        public int size() {
            return 128;
        }

        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (!(o instanceof Bitset128)) return false;
            Bitset128 other = (Bitset128) o;
            return this.high == other.high && this.low == other.low;
        }

        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(high, low);
        }
    }

    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int INV = 570000004;

    static int add_mod(int a, int b) {
        int sum = a + b;
        return sum >= MOD ? sum - MOD : sum;
    }

    static int sub_mod(int a, int b) {
        int diff = a - b;
        return diff < 0 ? diff + MOD : diff;
    }

    static int mul_mod(int a, int b) {
        return (int)((1L * a * b) % MOD);
    }

    static Map<Bitset128, Integer> index_map = new HashMap<>();
    static int node_counter = 0;
    static int[][] child_nodes = new int[65536][128];

    static int dfs(Bitset128 state) {
        if (index_map.containsKey(state))
            return index_map.get(state);
        int id = node_counter++;
        index_map.put(state, id);
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << node_counter); ++mask) {
            Bitset128 new_state = new Bitset128(state);
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << node_counter); ++j) {
                if (!new_state.get(j)) {
                    int k_mask = mask & j;
                    for (; k_mask != 0; k_mask &= (k_mask - 1)) {
                        int k_bit = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(k_mask);
                        if (state.get(j ^ (1 << k_bit))) {
                            new_state.set(j, true);
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            child_nodes[id][mask] = dfs(new_state);
        }
        return id;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        dfs(new Bitset128(1L, 0L));
        int[][] p = new int[7][7];
        int[][] q = new int[7][128];
        int[][] dp = new int[8][65536];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                p[i][j] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                p[i][j] = mul_mod(p[i][j], INV);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << n); j++) {
                q[i][j] = 1;
                for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                    int val = ((j >> k) & 1) != 0 ? p[k][i] : sub_mod(1, p[k][i]);
                    q[i][j] = mul_mod(q[i][j], val);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dp[i], 0);
        }
        dp[0][0] = 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < node_counter; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < (1 << n); k++) {
                    int next_state = child_nodes[j][k];
                    dp[i + 1][next_state] = add_mod(dp[i + 1][next_state], mul_mod(dp[i][j], q[i][k]));
                }
            }
        }

        Bitset128 result = new Bitset128();
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
            result.set(i, true);
        }
        int answer = dp[n][index_map.get(result)];
        System.out.println(answer);
    }
}
